items.title: Explicit variety-evasive subspace families for bounded-degree projective and affine varieties
items.author: Zeyu Guo
items.source_version: Complete61-page2024 journal version,computationalcomplexity33,Article10,published2024-07-16; mainTheorem1.7 with complete authorSection3 construction and directNoetherTheorems1.12/1.13 bundled
items.difficulty_reason: The author represents non-evasion by Chow forms, hits those forms in Stiefel coordinates, and combines rank condensers with the bounded codimension of nondegenerate varieties to reduce the ambient dimension before constructing the evasive family.

primary.label: Exact journal mainTheorem1.7, improved N(k,d,n), both characteristic bit-complexity bounds

proof_spans.label: Complete source-local equidimensional/irreducible reductions with finite-morphism and Stiefel background
Entire actual author simple/improved projective construction and complete affine conversion

contexts.label: Original base field/evasion/degree/Grassmannian/Plucker/Chow definitions with standard statements
Original degree-evasion convention, low-degree hitting-set construction/proof and cited rank-condenser primitive
Complete direct projective/affineNoether normalization consequences, bundled without another task
